ProcessBackend runs middleware in the child only; one rebuild rule for queues (#14)

- ProcessBackend hands its middleware to the child, which runs
  _compute_and_record: the parent no longer calls before_compute without a
  matching release, and LoggingMiddleware no longer logs the start twice.
  _worker_function and ProcessBackend._serialize_middleware are gone.
- Queue workers (StdLibQueue, RQ, Supabase) rebuild middleware by one rule:
  its class plus Middleware.worker_kwargs() (new, default {}; Logging and
  SharedMetrics override it). Four serialisers with two rules become one
  _middleware_configs. A class that rule cannot rebuild is refused at launch
  instead of being silently dropped.
